coach.headline: Great grip precision, now let your feet work
coach.summary: You locked onto every target on the first try without a single re-grab. Bringing your feet up sooner will take the heavy load off your arms so you can finish strong.

strengths.title: Pinpoint target accuracy
strengths.detail: Every hand and foot placement stuck cleanly on the first contact with zero fidgeting.

strengths.title: Solid upper body pull
strengths.detail: You showed strong core control holding your position even when your feet lost contact with the wall.

focus.title: Engage feet throughout the climb
focus.detail: Your left foot was on a hold only 21% of the time, leaving your arms to carry your full weight. Keep your toes active on available footholds to drive your upward movement from the legs.

focus.title: Keep moving through transitions
focus.detail: You paused for over four seconds on the big red hold in the middle while sorting out your next move. Preview your foot moves from the ground so you can transition through mid-wall holds without stalling.

drills.name: Sticky Feet
drills.how: Climb warm-up routes while watching your toe touch each foothold until your weight is fully committed.

drills.name: Two-Second Rule
drills.how: After grabbing a handhold, initiate your next foot or hand move within two seconds to build continuous flow.

coach.beta: From the red hold near the start, step your feet up onto the big red hold in the middle before reaching for the red hold in the upper half.
coach.next_goal: Keep both feet on holds for at least half of your next attempt on this route.
